name: Grand Theft All
subtitle: should have locked the door
rules: Put up to 4 characters, items, locations, and/or resources from your opponent's discard pile into play under your control.
notes: Card lists 'characters, items, locations, and/or resources'; catalog says 'non-tactic cards'.

name: Sudden Osprey
subtitle: who keeps a bird in a treasure chest?
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, that character gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: Honestly. A bird in a treasure chest.
notes: Catalog uses the TACTICAL keyword for 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic'; 'it gains' vs 'that character gains'.

name: Thief Doyen
subtitle: it's good to be the king
rules: COST – Discard a character or item. X is that card's cost. -- This card enters play with X tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Catalog says 'EXTRA COST:' and 'X is its numeric cost'; card says 'X is that card's cost'.

name: Recondite Hunter
subtitle: he'll never see it coming
rules: COVERT -- If this card attacks, it loses COVERT this turn.
flavor: "But if you're the police, who will police the police?"
notes: Catalog: 'When this card attacks, it loses COVERT this turn'; card: 'If this card attacks'.

name: Vander Malagut
subtitle: seething hatred, seductive wit
rules: UNIQUE EVONDAN -- All your other "sarcophyle" characters gain 1 speed. -- If a character is destroyed on a turn during which this card damaged it, put that character into play under your control. It becomes a "sarcophyle". -- If this card is destroyed, destroy all "sarcophyle" characters.
notes: Beta wording differs from the catalog: card says the destroyed character is put into play under your control (not 'take control instead' / damage reduced to 0), and 'destroy all "sarcophyle" characters' with no 'other'.
